              Specifications                                                Materials
              FUNCTION: SPST                                                BUSHING: Stainless steel / Aluminum alloy, anodized
              CONTACT ARRANGEMENT: N.O.                                     BASE: PBT (UL 94-A0), Nylon 6/6 (lock version)
              MOUNTING TYPE: Threaded front panel mount                     ACTUATOR: PC (UL 94-V2); POM (lock version)
              TORQUE FOR THREADED BODY: 11.5 kgf/cm                         INTERNAL ASSEMBLY: POM / PA66
                                                                            SPRING: Steel
              Mechanical                                                    SEALING / O-ring: Silicone (Translucent) / Silicone
              OPERATING LIFE: Momentary 1,000,000 cycles                    TERMINALS / CONTACT: Brass, Silver or gold plated
              		              Lock 100,000 cycles                           HEX NUT: Brass (Nickel plated)
              TOTAL TRAVEL: Momentary 2.0 mm; Lock 2.3 mm
              OPERATING FORCE: 4.5 ± 1.5N                                   Operating Environment
                                                                            OPERATING TEMPERATURE: -20˚C to +70˚C
                                                                            SEALING / PROTECTION: IP67
              Electrical
                                                                            NOTE: Specifications and materials listed above are for switches with standard options.
              CONTACT RATING: 2A / 36Vdc                                    For information on specific and custom switches, please contact Customer Service.
              OPERATING LIFE: Make-and-break cycles at full load
              		              200,000 (Momentary)
              		              100,000 (Lock)
              DIELECTRIC STRENGTH: 2,000 V RMS @ sea level
              INSULATION RESISTANCE: 1,000 MΩ min. @ 500 VDC
              INITIAL CONTACT RESISTANCE : 50 mΩ max @1A 12VDC
